name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The sentence 'at every moment the ball is out of the way ... carrying the key then, or pick it up later' is a whenever-rule whose response holds on that step or later, so hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches it, with the propositions in the right order. 'You have to' is hard, and the task has no unconditional command, so no Existence is needed. No clause is added or missing, and the lasting blocker_moved antecedent is the case the compiler clues accept.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door (blocker_moved holds), the agent must be carrying the matching key at that same step or at some later step (has_door_key holds then or later).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
